an5.83:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.
an5.83:1.3: Kuhako ca hoti lapako ca nemittako ca nippesiko ca lābhena ca lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitā.
an5.83:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca. 3.
an5.83:2.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato thero bhikkhu sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca.
an5.83:2.3: Na ca kuhako hoti na ca lapako na ca nemittako na ca nippesiko na ca lābhena lābhaṃ nijigiṃsitā.
